texts.value: Acts as a basic transcriptional regulator (PubMed:12489984). Represses basic transcription driven by several virus and cellular promoters (PubMed:12489984). When associated with BRD7, activates transcription of glucocorticoid-responsive promoter in the absence of ligand-stimulation (PubMed:12489984). Also plays a role in mRNA processing and transport (PubMed:9733834). Binds avidly to poly(G) and poly(C) RNA homopolymers in vitro (PubMed:9733834)

Binds RNA; this interaction is inhibited by high concentration of ATP (PubMed:9733834, PubMed:41971996). Interacts with the adenovirus type 5 (Ad5) E1B-55 kDa (PubMed:9733834). Interacts with NXF1 (PubMed:10668806). Interacts with PRMT2/HRMT1L1 (PubMed:11513728). Interacts with histones and BRD7 (PubMed:12489984). Interacts with TP53 (PubMed:15907477)
Contains an inactive polynucleotide kinase domain that resembles the PNK domain; this region contributes to RNA binding
The C-terminal domain, including the RGG repeats and the disordered tail, is important for RNA binding (PubMed:12489984, PubMed:41971996). The RGG repeats are methylated (PubMed:11513728)
Its methylation is enhanced in the late phase of adenoviral infection (PubMed:15242333)
May be due to intron retention
